note: Admin-art scoring pile (20 rows). Rows read by Claude from the doc line and code at bars-engine main, 2026-10-14. Wendell's steer: do the labelling, bring only real judgement calls. The four open rows are board questions jev-lab-*.

rows.statement: - **FR1**: Add `Asset` model: id, type, url, mimeType, metadataJson, ownerId, customBarId?, createdAt. Types: `bar_attachment`, `sprite`, `tile`.
rows.label: agrees
rows.why: The Asset model has every listed field (plus an extra `side`). Types are not enforced in the schema.

rows.statement: - **FR3**: Asset storage: Vercel Blob when BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN set; else `public/uploads/assets/{id}/{filename}`.
rows.label: agrees
rows.why: assets.ts saves to Vercel Blob when the token is set, else to public/uploads/assets/{id}/file.ext.

rows.statement: type String // bar_attachment | sprite | tile
rows.label: agrees
rows.why: `type` is a plain string on Asset, with bar_attachment / sprite / tile as the documented values.

rows.statement: metadataJson String? @map("metadata_json") // { intention?, altText?, ... }
rows.label: agrees
rows.why: `metadataJson` is an optional string mapped to metadata_json.

rows.statement: owner Player @relation(fields: [ownerId], references: [id])
rows.label: agrees
rows.why: Asset.owner is a Player relation on ownerId (it also cascades on delete, which the doc does not mention).

rows.statement: - Asset upload: max file size 5 MB for images; 10 MB for PDFs.
rows.label: disagrees
rows.why: The route declares 5 MB for images and 10 MB for PDFs, but the upload handler passes the 10 MB figure for every file, so an 8 MB image gets through.

rows.statement: - Nation sigil: 24×24px pixel glyph. 5 glyphs (one per element-nation). Designed, not Unicode.
rows.label: agrees
rows.why: The sigil check expects 24x24 RGBA in sigils/nation. The folder does not exist yet, so the 5 glyphs are unchecked.

rows.statement: - Archetype mark: 16×16px geometric mark. 8 marks (role marks, shared across nations).
rows.label: agrees
rows.why: The check expects 16x16 RGBA in sigils/archetype. Folder not made yet.

rows.statement: **Asset count:** 13 marks total. Not yet generated.
rows.label: agrees
rows.why: 5 nation + 8 archetype = 13, and the code says "not yet generated"; the folders are absent.

rows.statement: **Format:** 64×96px cropped square. Derived from Cosmic art — CSS crop at `object-position: center 15%`
rows.label: agrees
rows.why: register-portrait.ts uses object-position center 15%. The 64x96 size is not in code, but the crop matches.

rows.statement: **Format:** 4 move icons at 24×24px. One per move family: Wake Up / Grow Up / Show Up / Clean Up.
rows.label: open

rows.statement: **Format:** Tileable 64×64px RGBA PNG. Near-black on `#0a0908` base. Subtle grain — readable
rows.label: agrees

rows.statement: No image assets required — color derives from ELEMENT_TOKENS automatically.
rows.label: agrees
rows.why: Element colours come from ELEMENT_TOKENS in card-tokens.ts.

rows.statement: resolveProvenanceStamp(config) → sigil + mark chip (BAR card corner)
rows.label: open

rows.statement: - All colors must trace to `ELEMENT_TOKENS` or `SURFACE_TOKENS` in `card-tokens.ts`. No hardcoded hex.
rows.label: open

rows.statement: - `src/lib/ui/card-tokens.ts` — ELEMENT_TOKENS, SURFACE_TOKENS (authoritative color source)
rows.label: agrees
rows.why: card-tokens.ts defines both ELEMENT_TOKENS and SURFACE_TOKENS.

rows.statement: - `src/lib/avatar-utils.ts` — AvatarConfig, getWalkableSpriteUrl (existing; extend with resolvers)
rows.label: agrees

rows.statement: - `.specify/specs/provenance-stamp-system/spec.md` — Provenance Stamp implementation
rows.label: agrees

rows.statement: 3. Upload a PDF (< 4.5 MB for Hobby).
rows.label: open

rows.statement: For BAR photo uploads and book PDFs: `BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN` (from Vercel Blob store — create in Dashboard → Storage). Without it, uploads fail with FUNCTION_PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE or fall back to local filesystem (which fails on Vercel).
rows.label: agrees
rows.why: assets.ts and the upload route both depend on BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN; the route answers 503 without it.
